card.name: The word one before fractions
card.fires_on: The word "one" when it starts a spelled-out fraction such as one-third, one half or one-fifth. It usually follows "approximately", "about" or "to" in amounts, proportions or dose reductions.

modes.label: Approximate proportion
modes.description: "one" after approximately or about, giving a share of patients or cases.
modes.example: In about<< one>>-third of the cases, transaminase

modes.label: Reduced amount
modes.description: "one" after "to" or "by" when a dose or rate is cut to a fraction.
modes.example: Reduce the dose of MERCAPTOPURINE to<< one>>-third to one-quarter of the current dosage

card.writes: It promotes "half" and suppresses slash characters, so it pushes toward a fraction word rather than a slash.
card.plain: It marks the word "one" at the start of a written fraction like one-third or one-half.
